name: Agenda
description: Shows upcoming events from one or more Home Assistant calendars (Google, iCloud, CalDAV, local, ...). The card shows the next events; tap it for the coming days. Pick the calendars below and optionally give each a colour. Each card can show its own calendars and title, for example one card per family member.
author: Anton Timmers
